headline: ARI @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 5.87 at COL 3.49, with a projected total of 9.35. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved -0.40 runs while COL moved -1.61, changing the projected margin by +1.21 runs. The projected total fell -2.00, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Corbin Carroll, Jake McCarthy, Kyle Karros, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Edouard Julien because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
